  • Method Details

    • ensureDealThreads

      public void ensureDealThreads(Connection conn, String username, UserRole role) throws SQLException
      Make agreed/historical deals reachable from Chats even after leaving Incoming Offers.

      For the given buyer or seller, finds ACCEPTED/COMPLETED/ RETURNED deals with deleted < 2 and both usernames present that have no matching chat thread, then creates each missing thread. Caller-owned connection; this method never commits.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      username - the account whose deals are scanned
      role - UserRole.BUYER to scan buyer deals, any other value to scan seller deals
      Throws:
      SQLException - when a query or insert fails, or a stored deal type is unknown

    • findListingForChat

      public Listing findListingForChat(Connection conn, String id) throws SQLException
      Locks and returns a listing for a chat authorization decision.

      Caller-owned connection: this method never commits. The row is read with FOR UPDATE; only id, seller, title, type and status are populated.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      id - the listing ID
      Returns:
      the locked listing summary, or null when no such listing exists
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findThreads

      public List<ChatThread> findThreads(Connection conn, String username) throws SQLException
      Returns the chat threads the user participates in, newest activity first.

      Matches the buyer or seller username and excludes threads with deleted >= 2. Ordering uses the highest message ID (0 for an empty thread), then creation time, then thread ID. Caller-owned connection; this method never commits.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection; the caller owns its lifecycle
      username - the buyer or seller username
      Returns:
      the user's visible threads; never null
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findThread

      public ChatThread findThread(Connection conn, String id, boolean lock) throws SQLException
      Returns one chat thread, optionally locking it for a caller-owned transaction.

      Threads with deleted >= 2 are treated as missing; when lock is true the row is read with FOR UPDATE. Caller-owned connection; this method never commits.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      id - the thread ID
      lock - true to append FOR UPDATE
      Returns:
      the thread, or null when it does not exist or is double-deleted
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findOrCreate

      public ChatThread findOrCreate(Connection conn, Deal deal) throws SQLException
      Returns the thread for a listing/buyer/seller triple, inserting it when missing.

      The insert relies on the unique key with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, so concurrent callers converge on one thread, which is then re-read with FOR UPDATE. Caller-owned connection: this method never commits.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection with auto-commit disabled; it is not closed
      deal - the deal whose listing, participants, title and type identify the thread
      Returns:
      the existing or newly inserted thread, locked for the caller
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the insert fails or the thread cannot be re-read

    • findMessages

      public List<ChatMessage> findMessages(Connection conn, String threadId, String search) throws SQLException
      Returns a thread's messages in ascending ID order.

      When search is non-blank, only messages whose body contains it (LOCATE) are returned. Caller-owned connection; this method never commits.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection; the caller owns its lifecycle
      threadId - the thread whose messages are returned
      search - substring to filter by, or null/blank for every message
      Returns:
      the messages, oldest first; never null
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • findProposalMessage

      public ChatMessage findProposalMessage(Connection conn, String dealId, long version) throws SQLException
      Returns the transcript message that recorded a specific proposal version.

      Caller-owned connection; this method never commits.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection; the caller owns its lifecycle
      dealId - the proposal/deal ID stored on the message
      version - the proposal version stored on the message
      Returns:
      the message, or null when no message matches
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

    • insert

      public ChatMessage insert(Connection conn, ChatMessage value) throws SQLException
      Inserts one chat message and returns the stored row.

      The generated message ID is read back and the row is re-selected so database defaults are reflected. Caller-owned connection; this method never commits.

      Parameters:
      conn - an open connection; the caller owns its lifecycle
      value - the message to store; its fields are written as supplied
      Returns:
      the stored message including its generated ID
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the insert or re-read fails
